# Story 02 — CUSTOMERS-4-WEB agent adds a customer while on the phone (Story: CRM-63)

## Prerequisites

-
**CUSTOMERS-4-API (CRM-62)** must be shipped: the `POST /api/v1/customers` route this screen calls arrives with that

story. Do **not** land this before the API story is merged and available in dev.
- Coordinate with the
owner of `CUSTOMERS-4-API (CRM-62)` on the exact 422 field names for `email`, `name`, `phone`, `address` and on the error code retur
ned when an email is already on file (expected to be `VALIDATION_FAILED` with `fields: ['email']`, per the intake note "An address already on file com

es back as a 422 naming `email`").
- Read `.squad/plan-lessons.md` before starting — L-30
(fresh `Response` per fetch call), L-19 (audit ordering, not relevant here but part of the shared discipline), and the BR-6 rule about `

parity.test.ts`/`no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts`.

---

## Story Goal

Add a **web-

only** "add customer" screen an agent uses while a caller is still on the line:

1. A form with **Name**, **Email**

(optional), **Phone**, **Address**.
2. Submit `POST /customers` via `request()` (which already prefixes `/api/v1`) with **email absent**

— not `''` — when the field is blank.
3. While the request is in flight the submit button is disabled so a second click cannot create a second customer.
4. On success, the scre
en renders the customer that came back (id, name, contact fields, created-at) rather than a "Success" message; a

secondary control resets the form for "add another".
5. On a 422 the named fields are marked and the sentence sh

own is `t.errors[code]` from the shared error map — never composed from `fields`.
6. Every visible string comes from `web/src/shared/i18n/en.ts` **

and** `web/src/shared/i18n/ar.ts` in the same edit (BR-6).

**Out of scope:** any change under `api/`; searching for an existing customer (already

lives on `CustomersPage`); editing a customer (no story yet); granting a sign-in (CUSTOMERS-6).

---

## Context — Read These Files First
1. `web/src/pages/tickets/RaiseTicketPage.tsx` (entire file, 201 lines) — **this scre
en's sibling**, same four criteria (mark named field, disable while busy, show created thing, i18n). Match its shape clos

ely. In particular:
   - `marked(field)` helper at ~lines 39–42 (returns `t.errors.VALIDATION_F

AILED` when the API named that field).
   - `busy` flag and disabled submit at ~lines 44 and 192–196.
   - Success branch at ~lines 52–87

that renders the created entity in a `<Card>` and offers "raise another".
   - Error `<ErrorState>` at ~lines 94–99

that reads `t.errors[raise.error.code as keyof typeof t.errors] ?? t.errors.INTERNAL`.
2. `web/src/pages/tickets/useRaiseTicket.ts` (48 lines

) — the exact four-state hook shape to follow. Note:
   - `useRequest<T>()` + `run(() => request<T>(...))` at lines 32,

37–42.
   - Guard `if (status === 'loading') return;` at line 36 — copy this into the new hook so a repeat call

while busy is a no-op even if the disabled attribute is bypassed.
   - `.catch(() => {})` at line 42 — the hook exposes error via state

, callers must not re-throw.
   - Comment at lines 10–12 explains why `categoryId` is `string | null` and empty string is refused — **email is the same dist

inction here**.
3. `web/src/pages/customers/CustomersPage.tsx` — the existing customers list screen. Read the top imports and the router entry it
exports; the new "add" page will be routed as a sibling under `web/src/pages/customers/`. Grep for `C

ustomersPage` usage in `web/src/app/routes.tsx` and match the pattern when wiring the new route.
4. `web/src/shared/ui/index.ts` and
neighbours — confirms the primitives available: `Button, Card, EmptyState, ErrorState, Field, Heading, Input, Select, Skeleton, Stack, Text, T
extArea`. Use `Field` with the render-prop form (see `RaiseTicketPage.tsx` lines 124–152) only if you need a non-`

Input` control; a plain text `Field` with `value`/`onChange`/`error` (lines 116–122) is enough for Name/Email/Phone/Address.
5. `web/src/shared/api/client.ts` and
`web/src/shared/api/base-url.ts` — confirm `request(path)` prefixes `/api/v1` (base-url.ts line 3). **Do not

** write `/api/v1/customers`; write `/customers`.
6. `web/src/shared/hooks/useRequest.ts` — confirm the shape of `{ status, data, error,

run, reset }` before writing the hook.
7. `web/src/shared/i18n/en.ts` (~line 65 `customers: { … }`) and `web/src
/shared/i18n/ar.ts` — the customers namespace already exists; extend it in **both** files in one edit. `VALIDATION_FA

ILED` is already keyed under `t.errors` in `en.ts` line 58.
8. `web/src/shared/i18n/parity.test.ts` and `web/src/pages/no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts` — the gu

ards that will fail if you add a key in one language file only, or type a literal (including a separator between JSX tags).
9. `web/src/
pages/tickets/RaiseTicketPage.test.tsx` — the template for this screen's test. Copy the render harness, fetch stubbing (**a fresh `Response` per call**

, L-30), and the four scenarios: happy, 422 with `fields`, submit-twice-during-flight, i18n.
10. `.
squad/stories/customers/CRM-62/intake.md` — confirm the API contract this screen consumes: request shape `{ name, email?, phone, address }`, success

body is the created customer, 422 with `code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED'` and `fields: [...]`.
11. `.squad/plan-lessons.md` — read the

entries for **L-30** (fresh `Response` per fetch call) and the BR-6 line before writing the test.

---

## Product rules (from story)

- **I-1** — `users` and `customers` are two tables; `
customers.user_id` is null until first sign-in. This screen never sends or receives a `user_id`; if the API response happens to include one,

ignore it in the success view.
- **BR-6** — every visible string comes from a resource file, and the two languages stay in parity.

---

## Frontend T

asks

No backend changes required.

### 1 — Add the create-customer hook

Create file: `web/src/pages/customers/useAddCustomer.ts`

Mirror `web/src/pages/tick

```

Notes for the executor:

- **Path is `/customers`**, not `/api/v1/customers` — `base-url.ts:3` prefixes it. CRM-72's

tests caught this exact bug in a prior story.
- The `if (status === 'loading') return;` guard is not decorative — it defends against a caller who b

ypasses `disabled` on the button (e.g. keyboard Enter twice). This is criterion 2: "a second press is a second customer".
- Do not r
ename fields (`emailAddress`, etc.). The API's 422 `fields` array names `email`; the

input field must be called `email` so `marked('email')` resolves.

### 2 — Add the page component

Create file: `web/src/pages/customers/AddCustomerPage

.tsx`

Structure (follow `RaiseTicketPage.tsx` closely — a reader of one should recognise the other):

- `useTranslation`, `useAddCustom

er`, local `BLANK` object with `name`, `email`, `phone`, `address` all `''`.
- `set(key, value)` setter identical in shape to lines 33

–34 of `RaiseTicketPage.tsx`.
- `marked(field)` helper returning `t.errors.VALIDATION_FAILED` when `add.status === 'error' && add.error?.fields?.includes(field)`.
- `bus

y = add.status === 'loading'`.
- **Success branch** (mirrors lines 52–87): when `add.status === 'success' && add.customer`, render a `<Heading level={1}>` with `t
.customers.createdTitle`, then a `<Card>` with `<Text variant="muted">` labels and `<Text>` values for id, name, email (fall back to a `t.customers.createdEmailN
one` when null), phone, address, created-at (via `useFormatters().formatDate`). Then a `<Button variant="secondary">` with `t.customers.add

Another` that calls `setForm(BLANK); add.reset();`.
- **Form branch** (mirrors lines 89–200): `<Heading>` `t.customers.addTitle`, `<Text variant="muted">` `t.customers.addSubtit
le`, optional `<ErrorState>` when the code is not a 422 with fields (see below), then a `<form onSubmit>

` with a `<Stack>` of four `<Field>` inputs and a disabled-while-busy submit `<Button>`.

Submit handler — **email absent when blank**:

`email: null` or `email: ''`.

Error-state visibility rule:

- When `add.status === 'error'` and `add.error.fields` is empty/absent, show the shared `<ErrorState>` (as in `Ra
iseTicketPage.tsx` lines 94–99). When `fields` is non-empty, the per-field `marked(...)` messages carry the sentence, and no top ban

ner is needed — this matches the sibling.

Field wiring (all plain `<Field>` text inputs — no render

<Field id="address" label={t.customers.address} value={form.address} error={marked('address')} onChange={(e) => set('address', e.target.

**No literal strings, no literal
separators** between tags — `no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts` catches even a stray `" · "` between two `<Text>` n

odes.

### 3 — Wire the route

File: `web/src/app/routes.tsx`

- Grep this file for `CustomersPage` to find the existing customers route.
- Add a sibling route pointing at `AddCustomerPage
`. Suggested path: `/customers/new`. Import the new page from `../pages/customers/AddCustomerPage`. Keep the route inside the

same `RequireAuth` wrapper the other authenticated routes use.

less the other pages do; match the existing pattern in this file exactly.

### 4 — Add the resource strings (BR-6 — both files, same edit)

File: `web/src/sh

ared/i18n/en.ts` — extend the existing `customers: { … }` object at ~line 65. Add keys:

```

name, email, phone, address,

```

File: `web/src/shared/i18n/ar.ts` — add the **exact same keys** with

Do not add new ke
ys to `t.errors`. `VALIDATION_FAILED` is already there (en.ts line 58) and is the sentence shown for the API's 422;
other codes (`INTERNAL`, `UNAUTHENTICATED`, etc.) already exist and are what `<ErrorState>` renders via `t.errors[code]`. **Never compose a sentence from

`fields`.**

### 5 — Tests

Create file: `web/src/pages/customers/AddCustomerPage.test.tsx`

Model on `web/src/pages/tickets/RaiseTicketPage.test.tsx`. C

ases:

1. **Happy path** — render, fill all four fields, click submit; assert the stub was called once with body

`{ name, email, phone, address }`; on the resolved response, assert the created customer's id, name, email, phone, address, and created-at are visible in the DOM; the form inputs are gone.
2. **Opt
ional email absent** — fill Name/Phone/Address only; assert the request body **does not have** an `email` property (`exp

ect('email' in parsed).toBe(false)`), not that it is `''` or `null`.
3. **Email already on file (422)** — stub returns `{ status: 422, body: { code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED', fields: ['
email'] } }`; assert the email `<Field>` has `aria-invalid="true"` and shows `t.errors.VALIDATION_FAILED`; assert **no** top `<ErrorState>` is rendered (

because `fields` is present); assert other fields are not marked.
4. **Disabled while in flight** — stub the POST with a promise you control;

click submit; assert the button is disabled and its label switches to `t.customers.submitting`; click submit again; assert the fetch stub was called exactly once. Resolve the promise; assert the success view ren

ders.
5. **Non-422 error** — stub `{ status: 500, body: { code: 'INTERNAL' } }`; assert `<ErrorState>` renders `t.errors.INTERNAL`.
6. **Add another** — after
success, click the secondary control; assert the form re-appears with empty inputs and `add.status === 'idle'` (verified by absence of the

created card).
7. **i18n** — render once under `en` and once under `ar` (use the existing render harness at `web

/src/testing/render.tsx`); assert the title text differs, proving strings come from the resource files.

**L-30 rule for the fetch stub:** every
`mockImplementation` returns `new Response(JSON.stringify(body), { status, headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' } })`
**inside** the callback. A single `Response` reused across calls will read-once and the second-call test will time out r

ather than fail cleanly.

---

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Whitespace-only fields** — `.trim()` is applied before submit
for `name`, `phone`, `address` (see submit handler in Task 2). A trimmed-empty required field will produce a 422; the API's `f
ields` array marks it. Do not add client-side required validation — the API is the source of truth and the sh

ared sentence covers it.
- **Blank email vs typed-then-cleared** — both produce `email` absent from the request body

(Task 2 spread pattern). Verified by test case 2.
- **Double submit via keyboard Enter** — defended by both `

disabled={busy}` on the button *and* the `if (status === 'loading') return;` guard in the hook. Verified by test case 4.
- **API returns a customer with `email: null`** — success

view renders `t.customers.createdEmailNone` in place of the empty value. Enforced in `AddCustomerPage.tsx` success branch.
- **Server returns an unknown error code** — `<ErrorState body

={t.errors[code] ?? t.errors.INTERNAL}>` falls back to `INTERNAL` (matches `RaiseTicketPage.tsx` line 97).
- **API returns 422 without `fields`** — tre

ated as a non-field error; the top `<ErrorState>` shows `t.errors.VALIDATION_FAILED`. Enforced by the visibility rule in Task 2.
- **Unicode in name/
address (Arabic, emoji)** — no client-side normalisation; strings pass through untouched. Covered implicitly by the i18n

test case.
- **Route conflict** — if a `/customers/:id` route exists alongside `/customers/new`, order matters. Verify the `new` route is regist

ered such that it is matched literally, not captured by `:id`. Enforced in `web/src/app/routes.tsx` route order.

---

Plan

/parity.test.ts` runs automatically; it will fail if you forget a key in `ar.ts`.
3. **Existing, unchanged:** `web/src/pages/no-hardcoded-strings.test

.ts` runs automatically; it will fail on any literal string or separator typed in JSX.
4. **Existing, unchanged:** any routing test that iterates registered routes will pick up `

/customers/new`; if such a test asserts an exhaustive list, extend it.

Test file layout, imports, and render helper: cop

y from `web/src/pages/tickets/RaiseTicketPage.test.tsx` — do not invent a new harness.

---

## Verification Steps

1. **Frontend runs:** `cd web
&& npm test` — all vitest suites pass, including the new `AddCustomerPage.test.tsx`, `parity.test.ts`, and `no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts`. The

2. **Frontend builds:** `cd web && npm run build` — this runs `tsc -

b && vite build`; a change only vitest has seen is not verified. Fix any type error the build reports before landing.
3. **Reg

ression:** `cd web && npm test -- RaiseTicketPage` — confirm the sibling still passes; a shared change (if any) has not broken it.
4. **Manual smoke:** `cd web && npm run d
ev`, sign in as an agent, navigate to `/customers/new`, submit with a duplicate email; the email field is marked with the sh

ared sentence. Submit with a fresh email; the created customer renders in a `<Card>` and the "add another" control resets the form.
5. **AI-attribution guard:** `git grep -n
E "AI|Claude|Copilot|GPT" -- web/src` returns nothing new. Nothing committed may m

ention AI assistance.

---

- [ ] A field the API named in a 422 is marked, and its message is `t.errors[code]

` from the shared map — never composed from `fields`.

ked.

- [ ] No `api/` files were modified in

- [ ] `cd web && npm test` and `cd web && npm run build` both pass.
